gloss: defeated nation; loser country (in a war)

definitions.gloss: defeated nation; loser country (in a war)
definitions.explanation: A country that has lost a war, especially in the context of international peace settlements and post-war obligations.

examples.japanese: {戦敗国|せんぱいこく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{賠償金|ばいしょうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}った→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: The defeated nation paid large reparations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{第二次世界大戦|だいにじせかいたいせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{戦敗国|せんぱいこく}だ。
examples.english: Japan is a defeated nation of World War II.

examples.japanese: {戦敗国|せんぱいこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{周辺諸国|しゅうへんしょこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{進|すす}められた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The reconstruction of the defeated nation was carried out with the help of neighboring countries.

notes:
⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ (war, battle) + {敗|ぱい} (defeat) + {国|こく} (country). A formal compound used primarily in historical, political, and journalistic writing.

USAGE: More common in writing than in speech. The synonym {敗戦国|はいせんこく} is used more frequently; both refer to the same concept.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {戦勝国|せんしょうこく}: victorious nation
- {敗戦国|はいせんこく}: defeated nation — same meaning, more common
- ⟦{敗者|はいしゃ}→敗者：12941_haisha⟧: loser, defeated party — broader, can apply to individuals
- ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧: postwar — adjective/noun for the period after defeat
